info.description: Private service boundary only. A valid X-Hub-Credential and exact X-Codoxear-Hub are required; /internal/call additionally requires the authenticated user's exact-Hub-audience bearer credential. Credentials are never returned by this document.

Bearer.description: Exact configured authority issuer and Hub audience; no global account service is required.

BrowserCookie.name: codoxear_hub_{hubId}
BrowserCookie.description: Optional Hub-hosted browser BFF cookie. Independent static clients keep rotating OAuth credentials in this installation's IndexedDB.

IdentityCookie.name: codoxear_identity_{hubId}
IdentityCookie.description: Independent authority cookie uses its Hub ID; explicit shared-authority compatibility uses codoxear_identity.

ComputerCredential.description: Current Computer attachment credential, fenced by the Hub/Computer binding.

HubCredential.name: X-Hub-Credential
HubCredential.description: Private Hub service credential; X-Codoxear-Hub identifies the exact Hub.

DelegationGrant.name: X-Codoxear-Delegation-Grant
DelegationGrant.description: Private parent-scoped same-Hub grant, fenced by current Computer binding and initiating principal permissions.
